headword: {陸上自衛隊|りくじょうじえいたい}
reading: りくじょうじえいたい

definitions.explanation: The land branch of Japan's Self-Defense Forces. Besides defence, it is the branch most often sent to disaster areas for rescue and relief work.

examples.japanese: {陸上自衛隊|りくじょうじえいたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{隊員|たいいん}→隊員：32187_taiin⟧。
examples.english: A member of the Ground Self-Defense Force.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{陸上自衛隊|りくじょうじえいたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: My older brother joined the Ground Self-Defense Force.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{陸上自衛隊|りくじょうじえいたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Ground Self-Defense Force was sent to the area hit by the heavy rain.
